focus.jnote: The environment improved over the weekend. President Trump said he called off a “massive” strike on Iran to negotiate a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, with talks starting Monday. Oil fell about 6% (WTI ~$80) and Treasuries firmed as the war premium bled out; equity futures are green (S&P +0.6%, Dow +1%, Nasdaq +0.3%) after Friday’s strong close driven by Amazon’s 15%+ cloud-fueled jump. The VIX is back near 16. The catch: the 10-year yield sits at a 1.5-year high around 4.7–4.75%, the Fed is hawkish (markets price a ~65% chance of a September hike), and this is a heavy week — ISM surveys, a wall of earnings (PLTR tonight, AMD Tuesday), and July payrolls Friday. And the Sniper scanner boarded zero names, so there is nothing to place regardless of the friendlier tape.
focus.notdown: Mega-cap AI/cloud (AMZN, MSFT) and energy on the de-escalation crosscurrent are the tape’s talking points, but none produced a clean, boardable Sniper setup this morning. The scanner examined the full universe and confirmed zero Type A post-earnings gaps, zero Type B news gaps, and zero Type C breakouts that cleared the bar. This is a watch-only day — do not manufacture a trade the scan didn’t find.
focus.notup: Rate-sensitive and long-duration names are pressured by a 10-year back at a 1.5-year high, and any hot ISM/NFP print could add to that. But selling bear calls into a risk-on, oil-relief tape with a big earnings and jobs week ahead carries squeeze risk on any friendly headline — and again, the scanner boarded no bearish name. The disciplined answer is to sell nothing new today.
focus.why: Why YELLOW, not GREEN? Composite eased to 38 (MILD) and P(≥1% gap) is ~29% (below the 35% trigger), which technically clears the GREEN locks. But two things hold it at YELLOW: (1) the macro backdrop is still tense — the 10Y is at a 1.5-year high, the Fed is leaning toward a September hike, and a big data week (ISM → NFP Friday) plus PLTR/AMD earnings can gap the tape; and (2) more decisively, the scanner boarded zero qualifying setups today. No candidate, no trade. Stand down on new credit spreads and re-run the scan tomorrow pre-open.

risks: NFP · Fri 8/7 — July payrolls are the week’s headliner after June printed just 57K (vs ~115K expected). A weak print boosts September-cut hopes; a hot one pushes yields higher — either way, single-biggest scheduled gap risk this week.

10-year yield at a ~1.5-year high — the 10Y sits near 4.7–4.75% with the Fed talking tough and markets pricing a ~65% chance of a September hike. Any further rate pop pressures long-duration tech even on a risk-on tape.

Iran / Hormuz talks — the strike was called off and negotiations start Monday, but Tehran hasn’t confirmed a deal. A breakdown or any Strait disruption sends crude and the whole tape gapping — the week’s biggest tail.

PLTR (tonight) & AMD (Tue) — marquee AI prints in a market that has been rewarding cloud/AI beats and punishing misses hard. Single-stock gap risk that can set the tone for the AI complex; keep any spread clear of these names.

ISM Manufacturing (Mon) & ISM Services (Wed) — with the Fed having dropped forward guidance, “the data is now the guidance.” A weak or hot survey into a jittery bond market can reset sentiment before Friday’s jobs number.
